fields.Name: Feature Pipeline Golden Set
fields.Description: Evaluates a Feature Pipeline version on a labelled golden set: the pipeline runs as a dry run with the cache bypassed over every case, each output is scored (accuracy with accepted alternates) with a Wilson interval, and the result is stored on the version in MJ: Feature Pipeline Versions. A gated pipeline's version runs only when that stored result is at or above the threshold its spec declares.
